profile.summary:
My background is in biomedical research, and I am currently focused on open-source HealthTech software development.

I have a strong foundation in clinical and academic research, including studying infectious diseases, vaccine development, and ocular pathologies at the National Cancer Institute and Johns Hopkins. My academic background includes a BS in Biology from Howard University and doctoral studies in Immunology at the University of Pennsylvania.

I am combining this healthcare domain expertise with software development. I am currently expanding my programming skills in Python to build open-source tools and transition into freelance HealthTech development.
